newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Aug 5.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Aug 5.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Tuesday:
* On Monday, the Dow Jones industrial average rose 4.41 points to close at 8,198.45 as investors grappled with signs of renewed U.S. economic vigour.

* Indonesia's rupiah depreciation against the U.S. dollar was likely to help increase the country's non-oil exports, especially those of commodity-based products, Coordinating Minister for Production and Distribution Hartarto, said.
* On Monday, the Jakarta composite index fell 3.06 points, or 0.42 percent, to close at 718.71 points.
* On Tuesday, the rupiah was traded at 2,593.00/98.00 at 0130 GMT against an opening of 2,600.00/05.00.
*Kalbe Farma on a Media Indonesia report that around 70 employees of the pharmaceutical firm had lodged complaints with the National Human Rights Commission over their allegedly unfair dismissals.
* Bakrieland after an announcement the property firm planned to issue a 525 billion rights issue.
* Semen Gresik on a poor first half net profit.
* Bank Ficorinvest FICOR.JK after an announcement that Bhakti Investama planned to raise its stake in the bank to 26.0 percent from 19.41 percent.
* Toll road operator Citra Marga on market talk it was likely to take over the operation of some lucrative toll roads from the state-owned firm Jasa Marga.
* Indah Kiat following large cross trading of the company shares last week.
